title: Entergy Louisiana to build 2.3 GW of gas plants to serve Meta's Hyperion

sources.quote: The filing requests LPSC certification of three new combined cycle combustion turbine generation resources totaling 2,262 MW, each of which will be enabled for future carbon capture and storage, a new 500 kV transmission line, and 500 kV substation upgrades.

Josh Saul ,Bloomberg NewsAugust 21, 2025 2 Min Read Image: Bloomberg (Bloomberg) -- Louisiana regulators approved Entergy Corporation’s plan to build three natural gas plants to power Meta Platform’s biggest data center.

explain: Meta signed an electric service agreement with Entergy Louisiana for its Hyperion AI data center in Richland Parish. Entergy is building three combined-cycle gas units (2,262 MW total) plus a 500 kV line, with Meta contributing to the costs; Louisiana regulators approved the plan on August 20, 2025 (the date used here). Contract value not disclosed. Plants: three new Entergy Louisiana combined-cycle units, two near the Richland Parish site and one at the existing Waterford site (St. Charles Parish).
